title: Shmuel, brother of Rabbi Hoshaya

paragraphs: Hyman cites Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:6, where Shmuel reports a question asked by Rabbi Yirmeyah.

notes.text: The wording אמר ר׳ ירמיה בעי is abbreviated and its reporting structure remains unclear. A read-only Chagigah2:6 lookup did not establish this named passage.

The saved named Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah chapter 2, halakhah array index 6 (the seventh halakhah in that response), explicitly has Shmuel, Rabbi Hoshaya’s brother, saying that Rabbi Yirmeyah asked. This supports the nested reporting structure and corrects the earlier local hesitation. Hyman supplies 2:6; the differing numbering remains disclosed. No chair or purity narrative is added to the short notice.

Hyman (vol. III, p. 1132) gives chapter 2, halakhah 6. The passage is in halakhah 7 in both the Guggenheimer edition and the Daat presentation labeled Vilna. Shmuel reports a question asked by Rabbi Yirmeyah. Hyman abbreviates the quotation before the question itself.

The matching passage is [Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:7:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Chagigah.2.7.2) in the consulted edition. It calls Shmuel the brother of Rabbi Hoshaya and makes clear that he is reporting Rabbi Yirmeyah’s question.
